text:
Renee Park: Heads-up — Veritas wants a perf POC to validate sustained 3.2k QPS for short legal-summary generation. They want p50/p95/p99, heatmap, and committed vs hosted pricing by EOD tomorrow.

Tom Becker: Quick clarifier: 3.2k is all generation? Any embeddings/rerank? Also avg tokens per request?

Renee Park: Buyer: ~90% short gen (~140 tokens), 8% medium (300 tokens), 2% embeddings. They flagged a p95 SLO <=190ms for short requests.

Anya Iqbal: Proposed plan: 15m ramp to 3.2k, 25m sustain, then three 15s microbursts at +180% spaced evenly. Capture cold-start (first 3m), steady-state, and burst tails. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/sec, GPU util, and KV cache hit-rate.

Tom Becker: Runner snippet (pseudo):
```
loadtest --url https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/generate \
  --stages "15m:3200,25m:3200,5m:0" \
  --spikes "15s:+180%@10m,15s:+180%@18m,15s:+180%@24m" \
  --body sample_prompts_veritas.json --hdr "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --out artifacts/veritas-6187654321
```

Anya Iqbal: Token math: 3.2k * 140 ≈ 448k tokens/s baseline. Medium/embeddings increase burst memory pressure — plan to route medium requests to an isolated pool to avoid KV thrash.

SecOps: Security notes: Veritas requires CMK and log-forwarding. CMK without HSM ok on Dedicated via our KMS proxy; HSM/BYOK requires Private (longer lead time). Need buyer to confirm residency and SIEM ingest method.

Finance Bot: Pricing inputs needed: avg tokens/request, % long-form, desired committed horizon (1mo/6mo), and whether burst credits should be included. Also want per-token overage rate for hosted.

Renee Park: Buyer prefers 1mo and 6mo committed options and wants burst credits included. I'll confirm final token split and SIEM endpoint in the sync.

Tom Becker: Back-of-envelope GPU sizing: for open 30B FP16 w/ KV cache & batching expect ~3-5 A100-eq; 4-bit quant might reduce to 2-3. I'll run a perf sim tonight and post precise GPU-seconds & per-GPU throughput by 9:30am PT.

Anya Iqbal: Ops runbook: reserve stage Dedicated pool min=2 max=7, enable prefix KV cache, pin model hash, disable background auto-warm, and pre-warm route for short gen. Alerts: p95>300ms or error-rate>0.5%.

perf-bot: scheduled job veritas-poc-6187655000 (runner perf-grid-2).

Renee Park: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Veritas tomorrow 8:30am PT and include SecOps, Tom, and Finance. Attach sample prompts + questionnaire.

Tom Becker: Action items: run sim + GPU sizing (deliver by 9:30am)
Anya Iqbal: reserve pool + draft runbook (EOD)
SecOps: draft security answers and SIEM checklist (EOD)
Finance Bot: prepare 1mo & 6mo quotes + hosted estimate after Tom's numbers

Renee Park: Any blockers?

Anya Iqbal: None, reserving now.

Tom Becker: Starting sim now. Will post artifacts when done.

perf-bot: run started veritas-poc-6187655000 (ETA ~35m).

Renee Park: Thanks team — will follow up after the sim. :rocket:
